iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear

iran_conventional.notes: Day 61. BLOCKADE DAY 5: US blockade continues - 13 ships turned around. Hegseth threatens to resume strikes if talks fail. Oil Brent ~$102. Chinese FM calls Hormuz reopening 'international demand.' Diplomatic window narrowing. Probability 60%. Stable.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 61. BREAKING: Trump announces 10-day ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon starting 5PM. Netanyahu and Aoun to speak Thursday. Rubio hosted first high-level meeting. However, IDF destroyed Hezbollah sites in commando raids today. Israeli strikes intensified over southern Lebanon. Hezbollah claims 12+ attacks on Israel and ground troops. 35 killed in past 24h before ceasefire. Ceasefire fragile - Hezbollah rejected direct negotiations. 1M+ displaced. Probability 28%. Falling.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: RISING: Roketsan $3B infrastructure expansion - largest defense investment in Republic history. TAYFUN Block 4 hypersonic entering serial production 2026. EREN loitering munition unveiled at World Defense Show. Air-launched ballistic missile tests planned. Defense spending up 30% to $27.34B. Pushing EU defense integration. Warns Israel as 'Hitler of our time.' Probability 16%. Rising.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: CFR 2026 survey warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely - Tier II risk. Drivers intact - terrorism from Pakistan. 2025 Operation Sindoor precedent. Pakistan PM Sharif in Qatar, mediating Iran ceasefire simultaneously. No new escalations. Probability 24%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 65. RISING: Finland nuclear weapons vote expected in parliament. Kremlin warns 'will pose threat, force countermeasures.' Medvedev: Finland/Sweden 'automatic targets.' Finnish professor warns Finland could be first hit in NATO-Russia war. Danish intel: Russia ready for localized war vs neighbor in 6 months if Ukraine stops. Iran war windfall: oil revenues surging billions. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. NPT Review shaping as battleground. Probability 70%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: RISING: Taiwan tracking 'very rare' naval surge beyond typical 50-60 ships. Xi met KMT Cheng Li-wun - 'absolutely not tolerate' independence. Chinese tanker transited Hormuz despite US blockade. Taiwan MND tracks 9 PLAN vessels + 1 official ship + 2 others. PLA Type 055 destroyers live-fire drill. Taiwan launches military drills to secure energy routes. NSB director: China testing US aircraft frequency. $14B US arms for Taiwan. ISW/AEI weekly updates. Probability 35%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 61. SUSTAINED: Kim oversaw 5-missile test from Choe Hyon destroyer (Apr 12). Third destroyer test round in 6 weeks. Kim pledges navy operational capability boost. 4th destroyer under construction. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. ODNI confirms full US mainland ICBM range. Wang Yi visit strengthened China-NK axis. KCNA: cruise missile tests from new destroyer. Probability 85%. Stable.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1162+. SUSTAINED: 36 hours of Russian strikes - drones and missiles. ISW daily assessments continue. Russia warns Europe over drone production - 'unpredictable consequences.' Patriot missile shortage as systems diverted to Iran theater. Russia declares liberation of Luhansk. Iran war windfall: oil revenues surging. Russia intensifying sabotage in Europe. IISS: 'escalation, not stalemate.' 1.2M Russian casualties estimated. Probability 82%. Stable.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: SUSTAINED: China-mediated ceasefire talks resume in Urumqi - 2nd round. Fighting worst since Taliban 2021. Temporary Eid ceasefire collapsed, fighting resumed killing 2 civilians. Pakistan operations against TTP continue. PM Sharif in Qatar for regional diplomacy. Lowy Institute: 'the other war the world is ignoring.' Probability 22%. Stable.
